placements.title: Analytics infrastructure is chosen and moved on measured query performance
placements.frame: What analytics platform choice is being made, what performance evidence is offered for it, and when does the move happen?
placements.why: The CTO's announcement and the memo's bullets both ground the move to Zypherion in a columnar-query performance gain and a migration start. That is a subject future envelopes on the analytics stack will keep feeding. The 15x figure and the Q3 2026 date stay as evidence inside the position and are not leaves of their own.
